prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 9 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1098; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash. Examination findings and imaging clearly confirm the shoulder injury. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain in the same area, which resolved completely without residual limitation and does not account for the current presentation. Care was delivered over nine visits and followed a typical course, consisting of physical therapy, a home exercise program, and anti-inflammatory medication as needed. Symptoms and function improved steadily, and visit frequency was tapered accordingly as the patient progressed. Billing records reflect no repeated or duplicate charges for the same services. At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported near-resolution of pain with mild residual stiffness on overhead reaching. Plan is to continue the home exercise program and reassess as needed.
